notes.title: Minor Update EA 1.1
notes.content: Added disclaimer that you can not use old save files (e.g., from the demo and any past builds) in the Early Access game. You MUST start a new game, or else the game will crash!

notes.title: Alaris Enters Early Access
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42725786/7730d87b19cdff9083c833af83f04a32b3560399.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]IT'S OUT!!!!!!!![/b][/h3][p align="start"]​Alaris is OFFICIALLY in Early Access and playable to the public! For a price of $11.99, gamers can get early access to FOUR completed routes: Kayn, Druk, Fenir, and Etza. Purchasing the game now also gets you access to the game when it enters Full Release, and the remaining two routes that will be released then.[/p][p align="start"]It's crazy to know that we've come this far with the game. We've been working on this thing for so long behind the scenes, and now you all can FINALLY enjoy it after being on this journey with me for so long! I could go into detail about all the people who have helped me get to this point with my sanity intact, but my brain is so fried and I'm so nervous that I can't even come up with the words. So instead, we'll save that for Full Release. [/p][h3][b]Current Build[/b][/h3][p align="start"]For now, please enjoy the game as is. This is my child that truly took a village to raise. In this build of the game you can expect:[/p][list][*][p][b]CONTENT, CONTENT, CONTENT[/b]: ~250k words of content (~20-30 hours of content) spanning over four routes and eight endings[/p][/*][*][p][b]38 CGs[/b]: Unlock 38 CGs in the current build, which the LIs will gift to you if you are Worthy[/p][/*][*][p][b]CHOICES[/b]: Some that matter, and some that DON'T. Over 650 choices in this game---some of which will lead you to a good or bad ending, and many of which you can just choose to live your best life![/p][/*][*][p][b]A Customizable Protagonist[/b]: Choose your name, pronouns, and personality[/p][/*][*][p][b]Personality: [/b]Shape your personality with four different traits (Bravery, Kindness, Wisdom, Charisma) and watch how the world interacts with it.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Communicator System[/b]: Text the LIs and reap chaos in group chats, one-on-one messages, and more[/p][/*][*][p][b]Free Time: [/b]Choose from four locations and go on a date of your choosing with any of our love interests.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Energy Vision: [/b]Tap into one of the MC's special abilities to see the different auras of the cast.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Memories: [/b]Revisit free time dates and let our love interests woo you as many times as you'd like.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Support[/b]: Play using a wireless controller or Steamdeck for the gamer who hate sitting up at their desk for too long![/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]​[b]​PLEASE NOTE: DO NOT LOAD OLD SAVE FILES IN THIS BUILD. YOU WILL BREAK IT. START A NEW SAVE FILE. I WARNED YOU.[/b][/p][h3][b]Planned Updates[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Expanded Voice Acting[/p][/*][*][p]Additional Sprites[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded Sprite Expressions[/p][/*][/list][p]Kuna'a and Aisa's routes are currently planned to arrive together during Full Release; however, if this changes for any reason and their routes come sooner, we will communicate that accordingly! [/p][h3][b]Discord[/b][/h3][p align="start"]If you find yourself enjoying the game and want to talk about it with more people, we FINALLY have a [url="https://discord.com/invite/CK2EHTaYAG"]Discord[/url]​ as well where you can join other gamers in a safe, THIRSTY space.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42725786/1cacf1d72252e9bfa6ca383bc6414e6ec183d458.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Alaris Early Access Launch Coming September 19!
notes.content: [previewyoutube="93suRw6I5hk;full"][/previewyoutube][p]MARK YOUR CALENDARS!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! [/p][p]I am ECSTATIC to announce that [i][b]Alaris[/b][/i] will be entering Early Access in 9 days and will be playable to the public.[/p][h1]Early Access[/h1][p]With four of the six routes complete, [i][b]Alaris[/b][/i] has finally entered a stage where players can publicly enjoy full routes from the game. While in Early Access, players will be able to play all of the Central love interests' routes to completion, totaling in Four Routes and 8 Endings![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42725786/f626201217420435297bf0dd680b97770be303d4.png"][/img][/p][p]Early Access will give you all the chance to play the game sooner and see where the story is heading, as it's currently written, for our [i][b]Alaris[/b][/i] cast. And it will give me the chance to see how you're all liking the story and where game development has put us so far with the game.[/p][h1]About the Game[/h1][p]In [i][b]Alaris[/b][/i], you take on the role of a renowned healer who finds themself caught in the midst of a global crisis. After a dangerous run-in with a mysterious stranger, you find that the solution to your problems may lie in places never before imagined. In this fantasy romance visual novel, you'll be able to romance various love interests while discovering there are secrets in this world that have been lost to history. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42725786/bfe3119c76425ba40130a93973d490a4088f0495.png"][/img][/p][p][i][b]Alaris[/b][/i] enters Early Access September 19, 2025! Purchasing the game during Early Access ($11.99) will give you access to:[/p][list][*][p]4 Complete Routes[/p][/*][*][p]~240k Words of Content[/p][/*][*][p]4 Love Interests & 8 Endings[/p][/*][*][p]Fully Fleshed out Personality System[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded Communicator System (feat. Group Chats, Pictures, and More)[/p][/*][*][p]38 CGs[/p][/*][*][p]MORE THAT I'M PROBABLY FORGETTING[/p][/*][/list][p]My hands are SHAKING.... Can not believe we are finally entering this stage where you all can play fully fleshed out routes and FINALLY experience what I've been working on for so long. [/p][h3][b]\[ ALARIS EARLY ACCESS: COMING SEPTEMBER 19, 2025 ][/b][/h3][p]BE THERE OR BE SQUARE[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42725786/cd00def190f4529ed934ef0726f8a64a7727b870.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The Alaris Demo is Officially Out!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42725786/5105a24b6a5232e4bb373cb415e81d7cefbf975d.png[/img]

Thank you to everyone who has wishlisted and expressed interest in the game so far! Our demo is officially available to play and includes content on the common route of the game (3 Chapters, spanning 60k+ words), as well as other features, like Free Time Dates. Many game mechanics, such as Energy Vision, the Codex, and the Personality feature are present in the demo for you all to play around with. 

Because there is a lot of content in the demo and many choices, we do have a [url=https://crescencestudio.tumblr.com/post/690515814767558656/alaris-demo-walkthrough]walkthrough [/url]available. 

We hope you enjoy the demo's content, and if you find yourself interested in supporting the game, we have a 30-day [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/crescencestudio/alaris-fantasy-romance-visual-novel]Kickstarter campaign[/url] that will be launching August 15, 2022! We will have many physical and digital rewards available for backers, so if you'd like to see even more content in the game, consider tuning in for the campaign. 

Happy playing!
